messages:
Nina: Quick flag on PR 5102the Go SDK snippet in /console/tracing.md still shows the old context key `traceid` and the dashboard example PNGs don't match the captions (threshold vs p95). Opening because QA hit this while testing a demo.
Rahul: Ugh. I saw a few mismatches in the screenshots last week. Could be the assets rename from the last docs tidy. Which images are broken?
Nina: The doc references `assets/screens/console-thresholds-v2.png` but the actual file in the branch is `console-p95-v2.png`. Netlify preview served the wrong image in order.
Sam: Re: snippet, we recently standardized on `trace_context_hex` as the canonical param (to match the runtime's hex encoding). I can do a tiny PR to update the Go and Rust snippets.
Jules: Also noticed our sanitization pipeline strips `data-widget` attributes on inline HTML in markdown after the sanitizer update. That explains why the dashboard embed fell back to showing an image placeholder and the caption mismatch looked worse.
Nina: Thanks. Plan suggestion: (1) revert the asset rename commit on the PR branch so preview stabilizes; (2) add an assets-existence check to docs-lint; (3) Sam opens SDK snippet PRs for Go/Rust + a short migration blurb; (4) I'll re-author the caption text to be explicit ("p95 latency heatmap") and update the golden images.
Rahul: I can take step 2 and add a GitHub action that parses markdown for image refs and verifies the files exist in the tree. Should be a lightweight check.
Sam: Here's the Go diff I plan to submit:```diff
-  client.SendTrace(context.Background(), Trace{TraceID: "abcd"})
+  client.SendTrace(context.Background(), Trace{TraceContextHex: "0xabcd"})
```
Jules: For the sanitizer, I propose we add an allowlist for `data-widget` and `data-src` attributes in the mkdocs extension config. I'll draft a short change and test locally.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy queued: PR 5102 branch 'docs/console-fix-5102'. Netlify build: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/32999
Nina: Great. Once the lint patch and snippet PRs are up, ping here and I'll re-run the preview. Also adding a tiny 'Trace param renames' note at the top of tracing.md so customers know to check their SDK versions.
Rahul: No objections. I'll aim to have the asset-lint action in by EOD.
Sam: I'll open the SDK snippet PRs now and include links to the runtime changelog.
Nina: Thanks team. Creating tracking tasks: docs#5102/revert-assets (Nina), infra#docs-lint-action (Rahul), sdk#5102-snippet-update (Sam), mkdocs#allowlist-data-attrs (Jules). If anything blocks the demo, ping me directly.
